info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Management API enables businesses to modify cross-channel settings for customer workbench services by utilizing specific parameters. This API allows authorized users to update configuration attributes, ensuring that channel integration aligns with organizational needs and customer expectations. It's designed for administrators and developers who manage customer account settings across various platforms. This endpoint supports dynamic adjustments in a rapidly changing digital environment, enhancing overall user experience and channel efficacy.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific customer workbench identified by the customer ID. Ensure that the request body contains the necessary details you want to modify.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific customer workbench identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that the data provided adheres to the defined schema to successfully update the customer's information.
